assumptions: Surface tilt is assumed to equal site latitude until the as-built value is supplied.
Surface azimuth is assumed due south until the as-built value is supplied.
The exported TOTAL_ACTIVE_POWER values are treated as kW despite the source unit label W.
The exported TOTA_DC_POWER values are treated as W and converted to kW.
Satellite shortwave radiation is treated as observed GHI, not an archived issue-time forecast.
